full: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset: original Vaelora Sombral Mere merebloom lakeside tree, intact harvestable RTS sprite. Input1 approved ecology key defines its pearl bark, lavender drooping narrow foliage and deep teal shadows. Input2 defines broad matte painterly game finish only; DO NOT copy its maple shape. One compact graceful lakeside tree, slender almost upright pearl-grey trunk splitting into a few upward branches, root flare with modest exposed roots, irregular open crown of willow-like sprays of narrow leaves grouped into readable lavender/silver painted ribbons. Drooping foliage distributed around the upper crown, some deep desaturated teal shadow clumps, clear visible lower trunk for later axe cuts. Taller than wide, not a broad round maple and not Vesperra's petrol canopy with hanging purple flowers. Broad simple paint shapes, matte finish, neutral soft daylight; moonlit colours are material colours, no magical glow. No dramatic diagonal trunk, stars, moon icon, blossoms, animals, water, ground, rocks, reflection, mist, cast shadow, people, tools or text. True transparent background including branch openings. Entire crown and roots inside a portrait canvas with margins, lowest root contact near bottom center. Fixed orthographic target45 degree azimuth,45.4359 degree elevation,world Y up,zero roll. Intended world size about2.6 wide by3.7 high. Future stock edits preserve this canvas and roots exactly.
